verdict.rationale: Claude Code documents a sandboxed Bash tool. The operating system enforces filesystem and network isolation, so you can limit which files and network domains commands can touch and keep production systems out of reach while testing. Browser-based cloud sessions (no local setup) and custom skills like `/deploy-staging` also suggest isolated or staging workflows. However, this is an execution sandbox, not a documented test environment with non-production data. missing for 10: a dedicated sandbox/staging data environment or test-data isolation feature, docs on keeping production credentials and data separate during testing, independent or hands-on corroboration of the sandbox.
